description: This file implements platform-specific DNS configuration watcher for macOS, utilizing dynamic loading of system libraries to access DNS configuration symbols and providing functions to monitor and check DNS configurations.

classes.name: DnsInfoApi
classes.description: Encapsulates dynamic loading of DNS configuration symbols from system libraries on macOS.

classes.name: DnsConfigTDeleter
classes.description: Custom deleter for dns_config_t objects, calling the appropriate free function.

methods.name: GetDnsInfoApi
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of DnsInfoApi with loaded DNS symbols.

methods.name: DnsConfigWatcher::Watch
methods.description: Sets up a watcher to monitor DNS configuration changes.

methods.name: DnsConfigWatcher::CheckDnsConfig
methods.description: Checks current DNS configuration for unhandled options and resolvers.
